captions.detailed: A countertop bread maker consisting of a rounded rectangular base housing a hollow baking chamber with a rotating kneading spindle. On top, a large hinged lid can swing upward, featuring a recessed ingredient-dispenser pocket covered by a small rotating flap. A raised control panel on the front deck holds a fluted, rotating browning dial and three separate prismatic push buttons. The body and lid are finished in a matte light gray, while the buttons, dial, and dispenser flap are in contrasting dark charcoal.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a family-sized bread maker. The assembly should feature a rounded rectangular main body with a hollow baking chamber, a rotating kneading spindle inside, and a large top lid swinging on a rear hinge. Integrate a small hinged ingredient dispenser flap on the lid and a separate control panel on the front deck containing a rotating browning dial and three spring-loaded push buttons.
captions.factory: Construct the main body by extruding a rounded rectangle, shelling it to create an open baking chamber, and adding a small cylindrical kneading spindle inside. Model the main lid as a matching rounded extrusion with a hollowed-out pocket for the dispenser, and attach it to the body with a revolute joint. Build the dispenser flap as a flat cover connected to the lid via a second revolute joint. Finally, construct the control panel deck with three small cylindrical buttons (modeled as prismatic joints) and a fluted knob (modeled with a continuous rotational joint).
